tasks.title: Promote the staged oauth_applications and oauth_access_tokens migrations
dod: A migration spec shows both tables exist with the unique indexes on `uid`, `token` and `refresh_token` and the two foreign keys
The migrations apply and revert cleanly on a database that already holds users, projects and tasks
`db/schema.rb` changes only as the output of running the migrations
Lint and Brakeman clean

tasks.title: Promote the staged identities and legacy_token_uses migrations
dod: A migration spec shows `identities` has unique `(provider, uid)` and unique `(user_id, provider)`, and `legacy_token_uses` has unique `(user_id, used_on)`
The migrations apply and revert cleanly
Migrations 05 and 06 are still only under `docs/features/todolist/migrations/`
Lint and Brakeman clean

tasks.title: Install Doorkeeper with the password grant, one-hour tokens and refresh rotation
dod: A correct email and password at `/oauth/token` returns an access and a refresh token and leaves other devices' tokens valid (AC-08)
A refresh replaces the pair and revokes the old one; a refresh token 30 days old or revoked is refused
Stored token and refresh token values are hashes, not the plain secrets

Doorkeeper's own `doorkeeper:migration` output for the installed version differs from `oauth_applications` and `oauth_access_tokens` only where data-model.md 'Staged migrations' allows; any other difference gets a new migration
Lint and Brakeman clean

tasks.title: Add the user associations, Identity and LegacyTokenUse models and the Google-user password rule
dod: Model specs cover the associations, the uniqueness validations and `dependent` behaviour
Destroying a user with tokens, an identity and legacy-use rows succeeds and removes them
A user with an identity and no password is valid; a password user without one still needs a password
Lint and Brakeman clean

tasks.title: Authenticate with a bearer token first, fall back to the legacy headers and count their use
dod: A valid bearer token and a valid legacy pair both give the same access to the user's own data (AC-12)
Each legacy request adds one to today's count for that user; bearer requests add nothing; a pipeline-marked request adds nothing
With `LEGACY_AUTH_ENABLED` off a legacy request is refused with the existing Not Authorized answer and the user's data is unchanged (AC-13)
A revoked or expired bearer token is refused and does not fall back to a stale legacy pair for another user
Lint and Brakeman clean

tasks.title: Sign-up issues a token pair and enforces the sign-up limit
dod: Valid sign-up returns the three new fields and the legacy token (AC-02)
Malformed email, short password and mismatched confirmation create no user and name the field (AC-03)
A taken email creates no second user and says an account exists (AC-04)
The 6th sign-up in an hour from one source is refused with a wait message (AC-04b)
Lint and Brakeman clean

tasks.title: Count failed sign-ins per source and refuse above ten a minute before the password is checked
dod: The 11th failed sign-in within a minute from one source is refused without checking the password and with a Retry-After header (AC-10)
Successful sign-ins are not counted
An unknown email and a wrong password give identical answers (AC-09)
A request spec pins that the client address comes from the proxy header only when it comes from the proxy
Lint and Brakeman clean

tasks.title: Verify a Google ID token: signature, audience, issuer, expiry and verified email
dod: A token with a valid signature, our audience, Google's issuer, a future expiry and a verified email returns the email and account id
Wrong signature, wrong audience, wrong issuer, expired, or unverified email each return a refusal (AC-07)
Keys are cached and refreshed when a key id is unknown; tests use fixture keys, no real network
Lint and Brakeman clean

tasks.title: Add the google_id_token grant that creates a user or links Google and cancels all existing access
dod: An unknown verified email creates a user with an identity and returns a token pair (AC-05)

A verified email of a password user links Google; afterwards the old password sign-in, every earlier access and refresh token and the legacy token are refused, and the existing projects are visible with the new token (AC-06)
A capital-letter variant of the email links the same user, never a second one (AC-06)
Unverified email or a cancelled/invalid token creates and links nothing (AC-07)
Lint and Brakeman clean

tasks.title: Add POST /api/v1/sign_out for both authentication schemes
dod: After sign-out on device A its tokens are refused while device B still works (AC-11)
Sign-out with the legacy headers makes the old legacy token useless for every device using it (AC-11b)
An unauthenticated call gets the existing Not Authorized answer
Lint and Brakeman clean

tasks.title: Scope project and task lookups to the owner so other users' items are not found
dod: Showing, updating or deleting another user's project or task gives the same answer as a missing one, for projects and tasks alike (AC-17)
A request without valid access gets Not Authorized and reveals nothing (AC-22)
The owner's own operations are unchanged
Lint and Brakeman clean

tasks.title: Allow the Authorization header in CORS and read GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID from the environment
dod: A CORS preflight with `Authorization` is allowed for the configured origins
No client id or secret value is committed
Lint and Brakeman clean

tasks.title: Add the daily token and legacy-use purge and its Kamal cron role
dod: A task spec shows old revoked and expired rows are deleted and recent or active rows are kept
Legacy-use rows older than 60 days are deleted, newer ones kept
The deploy files define the `cron` role without changing the `web` role; a failed run raises an error that reaches GlitchTip
Lint and Brakeman clean

tasks.title: Document the sign-up, token, sign-in, sign-out and profile operations in the rswag specs and regenerate swagger.json
dod: Each operation has specs for every response listed in openapi.yaml (200/201/204, 400, 401, 422, 429)
`swagger/v1/swagger.json` is regenerated and lists the bearer scheme and the deprecated legacy sign-in
A spec fails if a response drifts from the schema
Lint and Brakeman clean

tasks.title: Run the project and task rswag specs under bearer auth and document the 404 answers
dod: Project create and rename, length limits and delete-with-tasks behave as AC-14, AC-15 and AC-16 say
Task create (starts as not started), status change and validation behave as AC-18 and AC-19 say; the status filter behaves as AC-20
Every project and task operation documents 401 and 404 and no longer documents 403
Lint and Brakeman clean

tasks.title: Make bin/swagger_smoke check the contract with a bearer token and keep a marked legacy pass
dod: The bearer pass checks sign-up, `me`, project and task create, read, update and delete, and sign-out
The legacy pass runs only while the legacy path is enabled and adds nothing to the legacy-use count
Another user's project answers 404 in the smoke check
Lint clean; the existing spec for the script is updated and green

tasks.title: Add client-side routing, the first shared CSS tokens and the landing page
dod: The landing route renders the explanation and both start options and no project data (AC-01)
Unknown paths still fall back to the app; the existing config, Sentry and error-boundary tests stay green
No colour or size is hard-coded outside `tokens.css` in the new files
Lint, typecheck and build clean

tasks.title: Add the API client, the token store with refresh, the Content-Security-Policy and GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID config
dod: An expired access token is refreshed once and the request repeated without losing the caller's input
A refused refresh clears the stored tokens and routes to sign-in
The nginx policy test shows no inline script is allowed and only the app origin and Google are permitted
`/config.js` carries the client id and the bundle check still shows no environment value compiled in
Lint, typecheck and build clean

tasks.title: Build the sign-up and sign-in screens
dod: Valid sign-up and sign-in store the token pair and open the dashboard (AC-02, AC-08)
Field errors are shown per field (AC-03); a taken email says to sign in (AC-04)
Wrong email and wrong password show the same message (AC-09)
A rate-limit answer shows a wait message (AC-10)
Lint, typecheck and build clean

tasks.title: Add the Google sign-in button and exchange the ID token
dod: A successful exchange stores the pair and opens the dashboard with the user's existing projects (AC-05, AC-06)
A refusal or a cancelled step shows the message and changes nothing (AC-07)
The Google script is not loaded on other routes
Lint, typecheck and build clean

tasks.title: Build the dashboard with the project list, status filter and project create, rename and delete
dod: A signed-out visitor opening the dashboard is sent to sign-in and sees no data (AC-22)
The list shows only the user's data; the status filter shows only matching projects (AC-20)
Create and rename show the new name; wrong lengths show the allowed length (AC-14, AC-15)
Deleting a project with tasks shows why it is kept (AC-16)
Lint, typecheck and build clean

tasks.title: Add task create and status change, the guided empty state and sign-out
dod: A new task appears as not started and each status change takes one action (AC-18)
Empty name or description shows what is allowed (AC-19)
A user with no projects is guided to a first project and then a first task (AC-21)
Sign-out clears the tokens and shows sign-in (AC-11)
Lint, typecheck and build clean

tasks.title: Give the landing page a stylish visual design (design tokens, theme, hero)
dod: Design tokens (colour, type scale, spacing, radius, shadow) in one place; light and dark theme follow the system setting
Landing hero with a visual and a clear call to action; responsive from 360 px; WCAG AA contrast; focus states; prefers-reduced-motion respected
No new heavy UI library without an ADR; lint, typecheck, tests and build green; e2e screenshot of the landing page

tasks.title: Give the dashboard a stylish visual design on the T23 tokens
dod: Dashboard uses the T23 design tokens; polished project and task cards, filters, empty/loading/error states
Responsive from 360 px; WCAG AA contrast; focus states; prefers-reduced-motion respected
Lint, typecheck, tests and build green; e2e screenshot of the dashboard
